arxiv-2102-07714.title: Uniform lower bounds on the dimension of Bernoulli convolutions
arxiv-2102-07714.creator: V. Kleptsyn, M. Pollicott, P. Vytnova
arxiv-2102-07714.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by V. Kleptsyn, M. Pollicott, P. Vytnova. In this note we present an algorithm to obtain a uniform lower bound on Hausdorff dimension of the stationary measure of an affine iterated function scheme with similarities, the best known example of which is Bernoulli convolution. The Bernoulli convolution measure μ λ \mu_{\lambda} is the probability measure corresponding to the law of the random variable ξ = ∑ k = 0 ∞ ξ k ​ λ k , \xi=\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\xi_{k}\lambda^{k}, where ξ k \xi_{k} are i.i.d.

arxiv-2110-06792.title: Flat relative Mittag-Leffler modules and approximations Thanks: Research supported by GAČR 20-13778S and SVV-2020-260589
arxiv-2110-06792.creator: Asmae Ben Yassine and Jan Trlifaj
arxiv-2110-06792.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Asmae Ben Yassine and Jan Trlifaj. The classes 𝒟 𝒬 \mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{Q}} of flat relative Mittag-Leffler modules are sandwiched between the class ℱ ​ ℳ \mathcal{F}\mathcal{M} of all flat (absolute) Mittag-Leffler modules, and the class ℱ \mathcal{F} of all flat modules. Building on the works of Angeleri Hügel, Herbera, and Šaroch, we give a characterization of flat relative Mittag-Leffler modules in terms of their local structure, and show that Enochs’ Conjecture holds for all the classes 𝒟 𝒬 \mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{Q}} .

arxiv-2407-03516.title: Three-dimensional Imaging of Pion using Lattice QCD: Generalized Parton Distributions
arxiv-2407-03516.creator: Heng-Tong Ding, Xiang Gao, Swagato Mukherjee, Peter Petreczky, Qi Shi, Sergey Syritsyn, and Yong Zhao
arxiv-2407-03516.description: Abstract In this work, we report a lattice calculation of x x -dependent valence pion generalized parton distributions (GPDs) at zero skewness with multiple values of the momentum transfer − t -t . The calculations are based on an N f = 2 + 1 N_{f}=2+1 gauge ensemble of highly improved staggered quarks with Wilson-Clover valence fermion.

arxiv-2501-09456.title: On the Relation between Optical Aperture and Automotive Object Detection
arxiv-2501-09456.creator: Ofer Bar-Shalom, Tzvi Philipp, and Eran Kishon
arxiv-2501-09456.description: Abstract We investigate the impact of aperture size and shape in an automotive camera imaging system on the performance of deep-learning-based object detection tasks, such as digit recognition on speed signs, traffic sign detection and classification, and traffic light state identification.

arxiv-2509-14414.title: Warm-Starting PCE for Traveling Salesman Problem
arxiv-2509-14414.creator: Rafael Simões do Carmo, Renato Gomes dos Reis, Samuel Fernando F Silva, Luiz Gustavo E. Arruda, Felipe F. Fanchini
arxiv-2509-14414.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rafael Simões do Carmo, Renato Gomes dos Reis, Samuel Fernando F Silva, Luiz Gustavo E. Arruda, Felipe F. Fanchini. Variational quantum algorithms are promising for combinatorial optimization, but their scalability is often limited by qubit-intensive encoding schemes. To overcome this bottleneck, Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) has emerged as one of the most promising algorithms in this scenario. The method offers not only a polynomial reduction in qubit count and a suppression of barren plateaus but also demonstrates competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods on Maxcut.

arxiv-2511-04711.title: SWAP: Towards Copyright Auditing of Soft Prompts via Sequential Watermarking
arxiv-2511-04711.creator: Wenyuan Yang, Yichen Sun, Changzheng Chen, Zhixuan Chu, Jiaheng Zhang, Yiming Li, Dacheng Tao
arxiv-2511-04711.description: Abstract Large-scale vision-language models, especially CLIP, have demonstrated remarkable performance across diverse downstream tasks. Soft prompts, as carefully crafted modules that efficiently adapt vision–language models to specific tasks, necessitate effective copyright protection. In this paper, we investigate model copyright protection by auditing whether suspicious third-party models incorporate protected soft prompts.

pmc-10526342.creator: Naga Jyothi Pullagurla, Supritam Shome, Ranjana Yadav, Debabrata Laha, Stephen Shears, Pavel Hozák
pmc-10526342.description: Jasmonic acid (JA) is a plant hormone that regulates a plethora of physiological processes including immunity and development and is perceived by the F-Box protein, Coronatine-insensitive protein 1 (COI1).
